SELECT rf.floor_id AS id, rf.poi_id AS poiId, rf.floor_name AS name, rf.sort_no AS sortNo, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.room_category_id) AS roomTypeCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rc.room_category_id ORDER BY rc.sort_no, rc.room_category_id SEPARATOR ',') AS roomTypeIdsText, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rc.name ORDER BY rc.sort_no, rc.room_category_id SEPARATOR ',') AS roomTypeNamesText FROM room_floor rf LEFT JOIN room_category_floor_rel rcfr ON rcfr.floor_id = rf.floor_id AND rcfr.camp_id = rf.camp_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = rcfr.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = rf.camp_id AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rf.camp_id = #{campId} AND rf.status = 1 AND rf.is_deleted = 0
AND rf.poi_id = #{poiId}
AND rf.floor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY rf.floor_id, rf.poi_id, rf.floor_name, rf.sort_no ORDER BY rf.sort_no ASC, rf.floor_id ASC

SELECT rt.tag_id AS id, rt.tag_name AS name, rt.tag_type AS tagType, rt.sort_no AS sortNo, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.room_category_id) AS roomTypeCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rc.room_category_id ORDER BY rc.sort_no, rc.room_category_id SEPARATOR ',') AS roomTypeIdsText, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rc.name ORDER BY rc.sort_no, rc.room_category_id SEPARATOR ',') AS roomTypeNamesText FROM room_tag rt LEFT JOIN room_category_tag_rel rctr ON rctr.tag_id = rt.tag_id AND rctr.camp_id = rt.camp_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = rctr.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = rt.camp_id AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rt.camp_id = #{campId} AND rt.status = 1 AND rt.is_deleted = 0
AND (rc.poi_id = #{poiId} OR rc.room_category_id IS NULL)
AND rt.tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY rt.tag_id, rt.tag_name, rt.tag_type, rt.sort_no ORDER BY rt.sort_no ASC, rt.tag_id ASC
